title: hieracium baenitzii
intro: Hieracium baenitzii, commonly known as Alpine Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium baenitzii include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
